name: smwmusic-leilani-wilson-alternate-hydrocity-act
title: Leilani Wilson - [Alternate] HydroCity Act 2
description:
An alternate song for Sonic 3's Hydrocity Zone Act 2, composed by Leilani Wilson as part of a project to give all the zones alternate music.

It's quite a groovy song, and it feels fittingly wet! I picture the smell of chlorine in a vast indoor pool network.

Check out the original here.
